description: PAPER PREVIEW (sealed:false, is_keep:false, paper:true). Not a verdict; for a verdict use get_lab_desktop_handoff. Backtest + chronological holdout + Monte Carlo computed by the Lab's Rust engine (same binary, same fees of 10 bps per side, deterministic Monte Carlo: seed derived from the fingerprint of the input trades) on the server's real OHLCV candles, resampled to the declared timeframe. holdout_percent: 10 to 40, or 0 for no holdout (Monte Carlo then identical to monte_carlo). Returns the fingerprints of the script, the plan and the data, and the quota (separate public pool: 8 per day per client). Explicit failure if the engine refuses or is unavailable. Descriptive, not a KEEP.
name: engine_robustness_check
